crossRefs.note: “So you shall divide this land to yourselves according to the tribes of Israel.

parallels.note: Now therefore divide this land for an inheritance to the nine tribes and the half-tribe of Manasseh.”

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: “So you shall divide this land to yourselves according to the tribes of Israel.
translations.bsb: You are to divide this land among yourselves according to the tribes of Israel.
translations.kjv: So shall ye divide this land unto you according to the tribes of Israel.
translations.asv: So shall ye divide this land unto you according to the tribes of Israel.
